description: Buildable MC-1 telemetry sample shape required to unblock real MC-2 projection and live MC-3 world-diff inputs.
notice: Matrices are serialized in column-major order to match the Rust projector. resource_pack_ids records the client-enabled pack ids used for MC-6 provenance; it does not prove the sweep sampled every required profile by itself. nearby_blocks holds surface-exposed blocks (non-air with at least one air neighbour) within a radius of the player's eye, nearest first, capped per frame; it is radius-bounded rather than view-bounded, so it is not a visibility claim and may include blocks behind the player. This schema still does not prove screenshot binding, live input, or live world-diff verification.
